import numpy as np

# Month-end total assets data (in millions)

y = np.array([6429, 7436, 6241, 7593, 7649, 7875])

# Fit a second-degree polynomial (quadratic)
coefficients = np.polyfit(x, y, 2)
print(f"Quadratic coefficients (ax^2 + bx + c):")
print(f"a = {coefficients[0]}")
print(f"b = {coefficients[1]}")
print(f"c = {coefficients[2]}")

# Create the polynomial function
poly = np.poly1d(coefficients)

# Extrapolate to April 1970 (x = 7)
x_apr = 7
y_apr = poly(x_apr)
print(f"\nProjected total assets for April 1970 (x={x_apr}): {y_apr:.2f} million")

# Round to nearest integer
y_apr_rounded = round(y_apr)
print(f"Rounded: {y_apr_rounded} million")
